notes: Eclipse Loop 1.0.8 - Undo is now one timeline. It used to keep four separate histories and drain them in a fixed order, so a pending knob move swallowed the click and an audio edit made afterwards was unreachable ("undo isn't working after I did half speed"). Undo now unwinds the genuinely most recent action, one edit per click, and Redo brings HALF / 2X / CHOP back - which it could never do before. The bottom knob row (DETUNE...STRETCH) moves again: it sits ~35 px off the bottom of a maximised window, so a downward drag hit the screen edge and the row felt stuck. Left-click now opens the menus on all sixteen edit buttons, with the old default shown as the ticked entry (HALF reads "0.5x speed (default)") - the one-click action is still that default. And the welcome screen is rewritten: 17 features in four grouped columns, led by auto-framing, plus REF, the performance row, sample tools, VST3/AU hosting, BROWSE/REC, Split Stems and ON AIR.
